_comment: Every word the store images show besides the real UI. {name} is the product name (store/brand.ts). npm run check:terms checks this file like the listing.

screenshots.headline: Open it twice, keep it once.
screenshots.sub: Open a page you already have open and {name} switches you to the tab you had. The popup lists any copies left, to close in one click.

screenshots.headline: Your repos, in your groups.
screenshots.sub: Rules put tabs into Chrome tab groups by URL, title or GitHub repo, with the names, colors and order you choose.

screenshots.headline: A Jira ticket and its pull requests.
screenshots.sub: Pull requests that name the ticket's key join its group. The side panel shows each ticket's status, and offers to close the group once it is done.

screenshots.headline: Merged? Close it.
screenshots.sub: Connect GitHub and the Merged tab lists your open pull request tabs that have merged. Close them in one click, or have them close on their own.

screenshots.headline: See what changes first.
screenshots.sub: Before a settings change moves or closes tabs, a preview shows exactly what will happen. Apply it, or cancel.

marquee.tagline: The tab manager that understands your dev workflow.
